title: Best Team With No Conflicts
goal: Build a maximum-score team with no younger player outscoring an older teammate.
strategy: Sort by increasing age, breaking ties by increasing score. A maximum-weight nondecreasing score subsequence then includes only compatible players while allowing all same-age players.
